column4: You have a masterful and supernatural grasp on linguistics, able to learn, understand, and fluently speak any language or dialect you come across within days of encountering it. This perk also grants you a mild cultural understanding of the many places you go.

Your knowledge extends to the very limits of maesterly duties, encompassing history, philosophy, medicine, science, and ravenry, with insights that stretch as far as Yi-Ti. Any knowledge a maester would have to know, you possess in spades, making you a scholarly titan of the world. Furthermore, your credibility grows to match your expertise; no one, not even the skeptical or mistrustful, will question your words. You are an authority beyond reproach.

You’ve mastered the dark art of poison-making. From the subtle and deadly Tears of Lys to the instantly lethal Strangler, no toxin is beyond your skill. You can even craft new and insidious poisons with effects tailored to your needs—toxins that delay their activation for weeks or only target members of a specific family.

You possess a trove of dirty secrets from across the realm. While you may lack leverage on fellow councilors or the royal family (for now), most others aren’t as fortunate. This cache holds enough damaging information to keep many people in line—or ruin them, should you choose.

Normally people forget things over time. Without prompting or need to remember a thing, we humans tend to forget what we’ve done, read, or been taught. Not you though, you’ll pass through death, rebirth, and all the years of childhood only to perfectly remember anything you need to know that you can ever claim to have known.

As a diplomat, you generally represent some powerful faction. As such, you have been provided with a great manse to show off your (and your faction’s) status. This lodging is almost decadently luxurious, coming with fine furnishings and an array of servants to look after it.
If you do any job you will be paid a basic wage by this drawstring pouch without any middle organisations. You can also access your money through this and it can’t be stolen.

Your mind is a perfect repository, retaining everything you’ve ever learned, read, or experienced with photographic clarity. You can recall any minute detail on command. If you choose, can forget or compartmentalize memories, allowing you to selectively block out knowledge whenever you desire.

A natural teacher and storyteller, you have an extraordinary talent for explaining complex ideas in ways that captivate and educate. Texts you write are remembered as masterworks, shaping society’s philosophies and traditions long after you’re gone. Your influence can establish entire schools of thought, religious doctrines, or cultural norms, leaving a legacy that persists across generations. The best teachers, of course, are also the best learners; you have an uncanny ability to absorb new knowledge quickly, able to master skills and concepts at remarkable speed.

Even in Westeros, the tedium of bureaucracy can be a barrier to progress. Building up an estate in King’s Landing, acquiring lands, or gaining the approval of other nobles typically requires endless time, effort, and stacks of paperwork. This item provides a self-replenishing stack of completed, lawful paperwork tailored precisely to your needs. These documents are accepted without issue, allowing you to bypass red tape effortlessly and complete your tasks without delay.

You have an incredible knowledge of flora life with an agricultural understanding that would be helpful in farming and foraging. If Winter comes you could grow crops during the harsh seasons. For you, it is easy to find edible plants, just as easy to find poisonous ones and you won’t mistake them for each other.

While the learned men of the Citadel normally reside in castles some roam the smaller villages of Westeros. They have finished their links in healing, history, ravenry, warcraft, accounting and higher mysteries but are willing to learn more.

Few places indeed have the art of instruction honed so well as Slaver’s Bay, but even amongst their number your talent is unparalleled - if someone has the potential to learn something, you can teach it to them far faster and far better than any other, and they’ll retain it far past where those taught by another would grow rusty. You needn’t use this for the kind of purpose the locals would put it to, either; there’s no skill you can’t teach save the ones you don’t know. And of course, a good teacher must know their subject - you learn just as fast as you can teach, and retain it even better still.

You have the Crone’s own wisdom now, and with it a gift for the scholarly pursuits that would shame any Maesters who try to compete with you. From numbers to languages, there is little written in a book you cannot master in short order, your mind working like greased lightning and your comprehension of such things matching great wizened elders five times your age. You have true wisdom now too, not just the ability to memorize things. As soon as you read something you understand it, on as deep and inherent a level as possible, and can use it to the absolute fullest extent possible in all the practical ways it is possible for such a thing to be used.

Money talks, and with it you orchestrate rivalries, disrupt alliances, and play your enemies against each other. Through carefully timed loans, gifts, or bribes, you can subtly fuel grudges, incite tensions, and drive wedges between rivals. Even allies of your enemies will hesitate to turn against you directly, focusing instead on whoever you’ve positioned as a greater threat. With this perk, you can ensure that those who seek to undermine you are too busy with each other to target you effectively.

You understand that everyone and everything has a price. In negotiations, you cut through emotions and morals, restricting the other party’s options to their knowledge, resources, and needs. You can convince anyone to agree to even extreme proposals if you can effectively sell the idea to them. This can come in the form of convincing a noble family to part with their treasured Valyrian steel sword or through purchasing an invaluable stretch of land one really shouldn’t give up. Even when deals border on the unethical or illegal, others will not judge you or the target unless they’re aware of the risks involved. After the deal, no hard feelings linger, preserving your reputation.

All of your monetary possessions are hidden in separate locations so your enemies can’t find them, while you can easily access them from this era-appropriate wallet. You can throw any money in the bag to hide it and nobody but you and your chosen companions can open it.

The Lannisters are the richest house in Westeros and even if you don’t have their fortune you have the ability to always get paid. You understand economics and can even get different payment types that are of equal equivalence. Winning a battle for a lord could allow you to be promoted as an example.

From a couple of halfpennies to a couple of thousand gold dragons, it takes work, skill, wit, learning, and good luck to make a fortune. Luckily for you, when it comes to matters of finance and economics, you’ve got all of that. You could create the Westerosi equivalent of Venice from a small trading town in a decade, and rival Braavos in another.

column3: A Song of Ice and Fire Jumpchain
column4: A pouch of golden coins. Around 100 Golden Dragons worth. May be taken multiple times.

Whether you are a Maester, or simply have the accreditation, you have studied enough to have forged a full chain, and are the equal of any Maester of the Citadel in academic knowledge. This knowledge stretches from healing to scholarly knowledge, science and the training of ravenry, who carry messages in the Seven Kingdoms.

Sometimes, a man of wealth has to simply drop off the radar for a little while. Now you can do so in style. This lavishly appointed town house in a foreign city comes with servants and a fiat backed guarantee that as long as you actively are trying to hide, that your enemies will not find you. This can also be used as a handy way to hide people - such as your crush’s daughter who you’re trying to turn into your sex slave - where they will never be found. Sadly, it does not come with anything stopping anyone from escaping.

Your medical expertise is nothing short of miraculous. You possess knowledge of anatomy, treatments, and healing techniques well beyond a maester’s usual training, including remedies for rare diseases and subtle methods for disguising poisons as illnesses. With the right herbs and techniques, you can heal with the power of the Mother behind you, or inflict harm with the subtlety of a whisper. In your hands, medicine becomes both a balm of life and an art of the Stranger.

A grand tome filled with maps and clues leading to legendary lost artifacts scattered across the world of Planetos. From the missing Lannister sword, Brightroar, to the mythic Dragonbinder, the book reveals the rumored locations and last sightings of each fabled treasure. While none of these relics will be easy to claim, every one will be possible for you to accomplish.

Your eyes were practically made for making money. With barely a glance, you can discern the true value and quality of practically anything. You can instantly see the differences between the blade of an apprentice blacksmith and the masterwork of a journeyman, and what makes it of more value and higher quality. You even intuitively grasp the value of abstract assets like secrets or knowledge.  Finally and arguably most importantly, you know exactly who will pay the most for these things.

You have a way with money that most don’t gain in their lifetime, for you’re able to turn investments into entire enterprises and find money in industries no one else would and how to manage your economy with ease. For this extends to cover all avenues of trade such as seaborne and others and you’ll always be the first to find out about new and more importantly wealth inducing trends. In the right position, you can sink an entire empire into dangerous levels of debt. You can easily do the opposite as well, and make the kingdom flourish, creating trade opportunities that wouldn't have existed without your expertise.

You own a shop chain of some kind which caters to some form of vice. By default, this is a brothel, but whatever it is, the business provides you with a stable source of income in the range of 500 to 700 gold dragons a year. The main benefit of this item is the blackmail it provides however, as whatever the type, your chain attracts the patronage of the rich and powerful. Thanks to this, you will regularly discover blackmail on various high profile individuals, as well as evidence to corroborate this. Sadly however, you cannot control who you gain blackmail on, so if you’re aiming to extort a particular person, you’re shit out of luck. You can freely import businesses to gain this effect if you wish.

When the barbarians are battering at the gate, sometimes you need a little something to pay them off. This provides you with that. This item provides a non-specific array of precious goods and items which, when given to another, generate far more good will than they should. It also enforces a geass which ensures that any deals sealed by the trading of these items will be kept. Examples of what could be provided by the Tribute include gold, jewels, food, livestock, slaves, horses, good quality weapons, and other precious goods. The contents of the tribute changes to be whatever the second party would consider to be a good tribute. The item refills once per jump.

Much like the Lannisters of Casterly Rock, you now own a truly impressive gold mine. This gold mine could be mined for centuries - millennia perhaps without running dry. In addition, you own a mint which will print valid money for you from now on. Please be aware that this does not come with inflation protection, so you could truly wreck the economy if you spend too much.

You have an unparalleled instinct for creating and growing wealth. From humble beginnings, you can build thriving cities, initiate booming trade networks, and enrich entire regions. Within a few years, a small port could become a thriving economic center. In time, your work could rival the prosperity of Braavos or Qarth. You seem to turn financial investments into empires, making you an economic visionary capable of completely reshaping the Westerosi financial landscape.
